meta.title: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Backend Engineer
meta.description: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Backend Engineer with 13+ years of PHP: architecture of production-critical, multi-entity commerce platforms (Symfony, Sylius, Magento 2), API and payment integrations, ERP/CRM synchronization and GitOps delivery on Kubernetes. Sofia, Bulgaria.

personal.tagline: Senior Backend Engineer · PHP/Symfony · APIs & Integrations · Payments · GitOps on Kubernetes

summary: Senior backend engineer with 13+ years of PHP and end-to-end ownership of production-critical platforms, from business requirements and technical design to APIs, data models, integrations and support. Architect of a Symfony/Sylius platform serving 5 independent legal entities (B2B, B2C, B2B2C) with per-client pricing, 15 payment-provider integrations (8 built from scratch) and ERP/CRM synchronization, delivered through GitOps on Kubernetes. Sets the review, security and test gates every change passes, AI-assisted work included. Earlier built systems for banks and insurers.
educationNote: Self-taught engineer — 13+ years of hands-on learning in production systems and published open-source work.

description: Own the architecture of abrites.com end-to-end — one platform for 5 independent legal entities (B2B, B2C, B2B2C) with per-client dynamic pricing — from requirements and technical design to deployment and support.
Integrated 15 payment providers — 8 of them built from scratch for regional requirements — alongside ERP/CRM synchronization and a Dolibarr ERP integration.
Maintain the internal ERP/CRM (Python/Django + PostgreSQL), a REST API (Django REST Framework + Swagger), a custom Symfony-based CMS and an event management system.

Set up risk-tiered quality gates for the live platform and new projects: each change's tier decides its review, security and test gates, and guard hooks protect legacy behaviour — built on my open-source Claude Agentic SDLC.

Built a GitOps delivery platform on Kubernetes: one generic Helm chart for all projects, Argo CD syncing from a self-hosted GitLab with CI runners, pinned and compatibility-tested versions, and isolated runtimes for legacy applications.

Delivered large-scale Magento (Adobe Commerce) projects in partnership with the Dutch agency Diract: customized core functionality, built custom B2B modules and processes, and redesigned the checkout and invoicing pipeline.
Built the Docker-based CI/CD production flow: containerized environments, automated build and test pipelines, and deployments to Linode servers.
Developed and maintained complex systems for banks and insurance companies, alongside projects of every scale.
Built custom e-commerce solutions from scratch.
Worked on a variety of small to mid-scale websites and APIs.

items.name: Vanssa Sylius Slider
items.brief: published Sylius 2 plugin; PHPUnit, Behat and Playwright tests, GitHub Actions CI.
items.description: Feature-rich responsive slider plugin for Sylius 2, published on the official Sylius Addons store — translatable image and video slides, live admin previews, Symfony UX rendering, Twig Hooks, and optional CMS integrations. Tested with PHPUnit, Behat and Playwright; CI on GitHub Actions. Developed through my agentic SDLC pipeline from human-authored specifications, with every plan, test and diff reviewed before merge.

items.name: Claude Agentic SDLC
items.brief: open-source pipeline gating AI-agent changes by risk tier: review, security and test gates.
items.description: Agentic delivery pipeline for Claude Code and Codex, built for legacy production codebases. Each change gets a risk tier (T0–T5) that sets its gates — planning, review, security and test agents, plus guard hooks against out-of-scope edits and pushes to protected branches — and ends at human approval. Tier-based model routing cut the cost of contained (T2) changes by 32%, and cost per request by 8.3% across 7,054 requests.
